description: This file contains PHP code related to setting up search configurations and Elasticsearch integration in SuiteCRM, including functions for installing search settings, configuring Elasticsearch, and setting up logic hooks for search index updates.

methods.name: install_search
methods.description: Sets default search configuration parameters in the $sugar_config global array and writes them to the config file.

methods.name: install_es
methods.description: Configures Elasticsearch settings in $sugar_config and calls installESHooks to set up related hooks.

methods.name: installESHooks
methods.description: Includes the ModuleInstaller and sets up Elasticsearch-related logic hooks for various lifecycle events.
